description: Read-only, paid-owner candidate schedules for one day or a span of up to 14 days (from and to are YYYY-MM-DD; from alone is one day; neither means next film week). Uses the owner's saved week inputs (per-ticket keep/consider/leave, films to consider, theatres, formats, minimum gap, seat tolerance) plus their preferred days, start window, latest finish, seat rules and A-List answers. Returns ranked, bounded, deterministic schedules (search says when it was cut short): each lists its films in order with format, advertised start, estimated end, the gap between films, same-theatre or drive time, the seat line (a kept seat, or "Seat unknown" with the owner's seat rule), exactly which existing tickets are at risk with the ordered steps, A-List weekly slots and the separate future-reservation cap, and when the showtimes were last observed. Always includes "Keep everything" with no ticket risk. Never offers a film the owner has seen, attended or whose ticket has started, and never proposes replacing a locked Top ticket. Seats, A-List eligibility and fees are NOT verified: say so, and tell the person to confirm on AMC. This never changes tickets, preferences or plans and never books or cancels; asking the booking agent to check a plan is done by the person in the planner.
name: get_week_plans
title: Plan your week
